name: Home Assistant
author: romeo
description: Control your Home Assistant devices from the Omarchy bar: a favourites dashboard, the full device list, and per-device controls for lights, climate, locks, covers, media, cameras and more.

barWidget.description: Favourites dashboard, full device list, and per-domain controls for your Home Assistant instance.

schema.label: Home Assistant URL
schema.description: Host and port, or a full http(s) address. Example: homeassistant.local:8123

schema.label: Favourites come from
schema.description: "manual" uses the list you star inside the plugin. "label" reads a Home Assistant label instead — Home Assistant has no favourites of its own, so a label is its closest equivalent.

schema.label: Favourites label
schema.description: Which Home Assistant label to read when favouritesSource is "label". Needs Home Assistant 2024.4 or newer.

schema.label: Favourite entities
schema.description: Entity IDs shown on the dashboard when favouritesSource is "manual". Managed by the star on each row in the Devices tab.

schema.label: Open links
schema.description: "browser" opens Home Assistant in your default browser; "webapp" launches it through omarchy-launch-webapp as a standalone window.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to poll Home Assistant while the panel is closed. While it is open, polling tightens to at most 5 seconds.

schema.label: Group by area
schema.description: Split the device list into the areas defined in Home Assistant.

schema.label: Hide unavailable devices
schema.description: Keep offline entities out of the Devices list.

schema.label: Show count in the bar
schema.description: Draw the number of favourites that are on beside the bar icon.
